card.text: Explore Pluto in 3D with cssEarth. Discover this distant dwarf planet’s icy landscape, its heart-shaped region, and its companion Charon.

introduction.text: Pluto is an icy dwarf planet in the Kuiper Belt. New Horizons revealed mountains, glaciers, and a heart-shaped plain during its 2015 flyby.

surface.title: MVIC color mosaic
surface.summary: Color observations cover only part of the surface, with detail varying by region. The gray grid marks missing imagery.

topography.title: Stereo elevation map
topography.summary: Colors span heights from −8 to +8 km, with shading to reveal slopes. The gray grid marks areas without elevation data.

monochrome.title: LORRI/MVIC mosaic
monochrome.summary: Images from LORRI and MVIC provide varying surface detail. The gray grid marks regions without imagery in this mosaic.
